authority: Root accepted the independent exact glyph and frame comparison to withdraw additional size, weight and family changes inferred from the earlier broad lighter appearance observations.

accepted_evidence.request: The original unselected MangaDex and Komga source-label strings and row constraints were recreated with Noto Sans CJK SC, 16px, weight 500 and #000000.
accepted_evidence.selected_face: Both independent Fontique queries and Parley layouts selected the genuine Medium 500 face without synthesis.

limits: The comparison is with an independent specified software rendering of the original label components, not the design-reference image.
It does not expose the original renderer's historical Typeface or ItemGeometry getters or establish a concrete cause for reference-rendering differences.
The source-derived frame projection was checked against pixels; it is not a historical geometry getter measurement.
No Candidate15 visual, runtime, full-round, native or final-acceptance credit is awarded. The original observations and artifacts remain unchanged.
